content.logline: Desperate to save an allied stronghold, a battle-hardened Three Kingdoms general must lead his exhausted troops across a deadly, freezing mountain pass before the enemy breaches the city gates.

scene_outline.conflict: Captain Shen points out that the sheer ice cliffs will mean heavy casualties before they even see a battle.
scene_outline.goal: Commit the army to the deadly mountain route.
scene_outline.turn: Liang Ping delivers a rallying decree, choosing the risk of the mountain over the certainty of their comrades' slaughter.

scene_outline.conflict: The cold and exhaustion threaten a mutiny as progress grinds to a complete halt in the snowdrifts.
scene_outline.goal: Survive the peak of the mountain during a violent, freezing gale.
scene_outline.turn: Liang Ping sacrifices his own horse and cold-weather gear to clear a path, shaming and inspiring his men into a renewed, desperate push.

scene_outline.conflict: The exhausted Shu forces must plunge down the scree slopes directly into an entrenched enemy formation.
scene_outline.goal: Break the enemy siege lines from the mountain descent.
scene_outline.turn: The surprise vanguard charge triggers a chaotic rout among the enemy ranks, turning a suicidal descent into a legendary victory.

story_arc.conflict: The army is already exhausted, and the pass is considered impassable even in good weather.
story_arc.summary: With all main roads blocked by enemy forces, General Liang Ping realizes the only way to save the besieged fortress in time is to march his army over the lethal, unmapped Dragon's Spine Pass.
story_arc.turning_point: Liang Ping orders the march up the mountain, effectively burning their figurative bridges—there is no turning back.

story_arc.conflict: Nature itself is destroying the army, pitting Liang Ping's relentless drive against his men's survival limit.
story_arc.summary: High in the mountains, a brutal blizzard halts the army's progress. Men begin to freeze and collapse, prompting Captain Shen to plead for a retreat.
story_arc.turning_point: Liang Ping strips off his heavy commander's armor and leads from the front, manually pulling supply carts through the snow to inspire the troops to keep moving.

story_arc.conflict: The attacking soldiers are half-frozen and starving, facing a well-rested and vastly larger besieging force.
story_arc.summary: The surviving troops reach the summit and charge down the mountain slopes, crashing into the rear of the enemy siege camp with unstoppable momentum.
story_arc.turning_point: The sheer shock and ferocious momentum of an army descending from an 'impossible' flank shatters enemy morale, breaking the siege.

locations.prompt_summary: Cast in dark, high-contrast cold blues of dusk, with wind violently whipping snow off the ice cliffs.

props.prompt_summary: Sheathed, catching the faint, cold ambient light of the dusk sky.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A blinding, swirling snowstorm completely obscures the landscape in pitch-black darkness. Several anonymous soldiers lie collapsed face-first in deep, frozen snowdrifts. Sputtering orange torches struggle against the violent wind.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: Thick, chaotic snow particles blast rapidly across the frame, almost completely whiting out the view. The small torch flames flicker violently and die out.

keyframes.prompt_summary: Looking down from a slight high angle, Captain Shen struggles against the violent blizzard. He holds the weight of a half-frozen soldier against his side. Shen's face is a portrait of despair, his mouth open wide as he screams into the howling wind.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: Shen struggles to keep his balance as the wind brutally pushes against him and his limp comrade. Heavy snow continues to accumulate rapidly on his shaking shoulders.

keyframes.prompt_summary: General Liang Ping stands in the heavy snowstorm, forcefully throwing his heavy commander's armor and thick winter cloak into a nearby snowdrift. He is left wearing only a thin, dark under-tunic. The discarded armor lands heavily in the accumulating white powder.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The heavy armor crashes dynamically into the deep snowdrift, sending white powder flying into the air. Liang Ping's thin tunic whips violently in the gale-force winds.

keyframes.prompt_summary: Viewed from a low angle, General Liang Ping strains forcefully against the thick, icy ropes of a massive wooden supply cart. Wearing only his thin tunic, his muscles bulge with effort as he single-handedly drags the heavy cart through the deep snowdrift.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera tracks slowly alongside Liang Ping as he takes agonizing, heavy steps forward. The large wooden wheels of the cart slowly rotate, churning through the thick snow.

characters.prompt_summary: Stripped down to a thin under-tunic, his arms exposed to the brutal cold. His breath mists violently in the pitch-black night as snow accumulates on his skin.
Lamellar armor completely caked in thick ice and snow. He is shivering uncontrollably with ice forming deep in his eyebrows.

locations.prompt_summary: Swallowed in claustrophobic, pitch-black darkness and blinding white snowdrifts. Faintly illuminated by the flickering glow of dying orange torches.

props.prompt_summary: Wooden wheels buried deep in thick snowdrifts, with thick ropes coated entirely in a layer of heavy frost.
Discarded haphazardly into a deep snowdrift, rapidly being buried by the swirling blizzard.

keyframes.prompt_summary: General Liang Ping stands at the edge of a snowy summit, looking down. Over his shoulder, the vast expanse of a massive, sleeping enemy siege camp fills the valley floor far below. The entire landscape is bathed in the brilliant golden light of dawn.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: A sweeping camera tilt moves downward from Liang Ping's freezing vantage point to reveal the staggering scale of the enemy camp below. The morning wind lightly ripples his tunic.

keyframes.prompt_summary: Captured from a heroic low angle against the bright dawn sky, General Liang Ping roars a ferocious battle cry. His skin is pale with frost, and his wild hair blows in the wind. He thrusts his drawn sword forcefully forward toward the valley.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: Liang Ping forcefully thrusts his sword forward in a dynamic, aggressive motion. His chest heaves as he shouts his command into the crisp morning air.

keyframes.prompt_summary: Viewed from a high angle, a ragged army of half-frozen soldiers charges violently down a steep, rocky scree slope. General Liang Ping and Captain Shen lead the ferocious descent. The charging vanguard crashes wildly into the unprepared canvas tents of the enemy rear guard.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera tracks quickly down the treacherous slope, keeping pace with the chaotic, avalanche-like charge of the soldiers. Enemy tents tear and collapse violently upon impact.

characters.prompt_summary: Still wearing only a thin tunic fluttering in the morning wind. His skin is pale with frost but his expression is fiercely determined in the bright dawn light.
Covered in battered, snow-caked armor, standing tall with a newly fearless and determined posture.

props.prompt_summary: Drawn and fully exposed, the worn steel blade gleaming brightly in the warm dawn sunlight.
